title: LB Greenlaw returns to 49ers as DE Huff retires

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: LB Greenlaw returns to 49ers as DE Huff retires
sources.description: Linebacker Dre Greenlaw is returning to the 49ers, agreeing to terms on a one-year, $7.5 million contract, a source told ESPN. Defensive end Bryce Huff, however, is retiring from the NFL, he announced.
